text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh. Excellent! Just a little
more and I'm
done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho is laughing boldly,
sparking her
dorm leader, Fuji Kiseki, to
come check on her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. I certainly didn't expect to find
you
making sweets when I heard all that
racket.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Even I can bake a bit! I'm making
chocolates
for Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna feed them to my familiar and
make
them do whatever I say!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you've got a special Valentine's
magazine...
"Chocolate recipes to steal
their heart," huh?
Hehe, sounds
promising!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my super deluxe baked chocolates
are almost
done!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Eugh! Gross! Why do they smell like
that?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Just curious, but what did you
put in
them?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I only used normal ingredients, just like
the
magazine said! Chocolate, powdered
sugar...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Plus some mugwort and chameleon plant
to
enhance the effects. Oh, and I also
added some
boiled-down mulberry and
multiflora rose!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see. It sounds like quite a high
concentration of
magical power! Do you
think your familiar can
handle it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh! Good point... You'd think my familiar would have a lot of magic power, but that is not the case!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you should make another batch.
I'd be
happy to help, if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Okay, the ingredients and measurements
seem
okay! So far, everything is just like
the recipe
says.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now it says we have to bake it
thoroughly in the
oven! What do they
think I am, some kinda
normie?! I can
have it ready in no time at all with
a
little magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Burn it all! Scarlet ☆ sage... Turn up the
heat!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oopsie... Looks like you're using a lot of
magical
power! I'm just going to adjust it
a smidge so you
don't run out!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now all we have to do is wrap it! I'll use
some
magic string to tie it up so the
magical power
doesn't escape!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh? But according to this grimoire, you
should
wrap it up with a cute bow to
drive the recipient
crazy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right! There sure is a lot of
depth to
this charm magic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm working in my office one day when a
very
cheerful Sweep Tosho drops by.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's Day, Familiar! Here,
these
deluxe baked chocolates are for
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right... Today is Valentine's Day.
I've been
so busy that I completely
forgot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open the box, and the smell of baked
chocolate
fills the room. It looks great!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
They're super special chocolates I made
just for
you! If you eat one—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure you'll already be captivated by
the time
you notice anything! And
then...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(You'll do whatever I say and become
even more
familiar-y!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! One bite and I'm sure you'll be
hooked! Fuji
helped me make the magic
a bit more mild, so it
should be perfect
for you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's right. We made them tog—huh?
choice_data_list: 2人からのチョコってことか

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Wait a second! If there's magic from
both of us in
there, that means...)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You know, Familiar. I think I have quite a
bit of
work you could do for me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. And it's not as if you can refuse.
You're
crazy about me, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No way I'm letting that happen!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You're my familiar! Give those chocolates back right this instant!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She grabs the box back so fast I don't
even see
her move!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Don't you question me! No means no!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho runs off with the
chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No way I'm letting that happen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I put one in my mouth. It's crisp on the
outside
and soft on the inside. Any
bakery would be
proud to sell chocolate
this good!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Aaagh! Why did you do that?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Idiot! You stupid idiot! Now the magic is
going to
take effect!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just to make sure... You wouldn't do
anything for
Fuji if she asked you to,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ugh! What are you saying?! You're my familiar!
choice_data_list: 困っているなら手伝うかも？

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It looks like I need to do a reversal
ritual! Go lie
down on the sofa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might be best not to resist... I do as
she says
and lie down.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Epimedium, epimedium! Return this soul
to its
master! Pronto!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...There! How do you feel? Do you
remember who
your true master is?! Me
or Fuji?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Phew... You're such a handful! I'm not
gonna help
you next time you decide to
just eat whatever
you find off the street!
Got it?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She isn't particularly good at expressing
herself,
but it seems like she cares about
me. This
Valentine's Day has made that
abundantly clear!
